description: This file defines the internal class SingleWaiterAutoResetEvent, a synchronization primitive that supports signaling and waiting for a single waiter, with support for asynchronous wait operations. It manages internal state flags to coordinate signaling and waiting, and implements the IValueTaskSource interface for efficient async handling.

classes.name: SingleWaiterAutoResetEvent
classes.description: A synchronization event supporting a single waiter that automatically resets after signaling. Implements IValueTaskSource for asynchronous wait operations.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Signals the event, waking the waiter if present.

methods.name: WaitAsync
methods.description: Returns a ValueTask that completes when the event is signaled.

methods.name: ResetStatus
methods.description: Resets internal status flags after the event is handled.
